policy: Do not assume projection, vertical datum, pixel units, quality, or frame for a new raster. Verify metadata and detached PDS labels before ingestion. Do not interpolate across gaps or silently switch sources.

ingestion_rules: Only the first source has been downloaded and verified. Others are design candidates, not available inputs.
One tile has one chosen primary terrain source and an explicit source_id; record any secondary source rather than blending silently.
Store the source's complete affine/CRS or PDS map projection parameters and vertical datum plus native file hash.
No interpolation of NoData unless a later named version explicitly allows it; missing stays missing.
Record seams when source_id, provenance, resolution, effective resolution, quality or frame changes.
No source supplies independent laser shot heights for every DEM pixel. Retain raw source raster, labels, and quality layers.
Before global metric slope calculations, handle angular lat/lon rasters with a local lunar metric conversion or geodesic horizontal distances. Never use metres-per-degree as a constant globally.
